facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi's Director of National Payments System said proposed regulations were being developed to address emerging challenges in the payments sector.
facts.system: Reserve Bank of Malawi payments regulations

MWI.note: Fees and fraud are discussed; no consumer rule or complaints body stated.
Remittance fee figures name no corridor or channel; a fee level is not a measured corridor cost.
Nothing on government payments to people.
An 88% financial inclusion rate is given with no survey or account measure named.

facts.fact: Registered mobile money subscribers reached 20 million by the second quarter of 2025, with transactions valued at K8.6 trillion, mostly airtime, cash-in and cash-out, person-to-person and merchant payments.

MWI.note: Only taxes on digital transactions are discussed, not electronic payment of taxes.
